job: Generate or refactor one educational content unit in one linear pass: a teacher brief that constrains everything after it, one written edition per declared language, images made to a stated claim, code and executable checks that actually run, and an independent critique that receives the artifact without the producer's rationale.

refs.purpose: The lesson as served; the unit being authored or revised.
The AI runtime that runs, reads, and repairs generated code.
A prior audit of the same unit; regression history.

sideEffects: write only the brief, article, image, prompt, implementation, and critique artifacts under the declared targets
run only the declared build and executable-check commands
forbiddenSideEffects: write an article before the brief is frozen, or beyond what the brief published
claim a learning outcome, example, or visual claim the brief does not publish
report a build or executable check that was not run, or whose exit code was not read
change the executable contract during a repair loop
let the producer of an artifact perform, steer, or brief its own critique
approve a unit while any applicable score sits below the published minimum
stopConditions: the teacher brief cannot be frozen from the bound curriculum and source evidence
a declared language edition leaves a published learning outcome uncovered
a declared implementation track does not build
a declared executable check fails, or the contract fingerprint moved during repair
a required image cannot be generated to the brief's claims
the independent critique returns a revision, or the approved review rounds are exhausted
the observed source head differs from the frozen head
a resume adds no effective curriculum, source, finding, or scope delta
